official.deadline_note: Registration in the Beca Doctoral 2027-1 admission process runs 10 August to 4 November 2026 and the registration fee must be paid by 5 November 2026, with evaluation documents in Kissflow by 5 November 2026. This scholarship cycle is far earlier than the general master's/doctoral 2027-1 admission calendar, which runs to 16 February 2027, so a candidate who misses 4 November cannot join the grant call for that intake.
official.application_cycle: Beca Doctoral 2027-1 (inscription in the 2027-1 PUCP doctoral admission process; classes start 22 March 2027)
official.status_note: The official call page states 'Del 10 de agosto al 04 de noviembre del 2026' and the grants are awarded after the doctoral admission results are published on 19 November 2026, with the beneficiary list published on 3 December 2026 and agreements signed 9-11 December 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: La Escuela de Posgrado, a través de los programas de Doctorado respectivos, cubrirá los derechos académicos y de matrícula.
benefits: La Escuela de Posgrado, a través de los programas de Doctorado respectivos, cubrirá los derechos académicos y de matrícula.

El Vicerrectorado de Investigación brindará una asignación por concepto de manutención, por un importe mensual de S/ 4,000 (cuatro mil y 00/100 soles) durante 12 meses renovables para el desarrollo de la investigación doctoral.
Se brindará el seguro contra accidentes personales PUCP.
Se contará con la filiación institucional PUCP.

Se brindará un espacio de trabajo con condiciones adecuadas para el desarrollo de la propuesta en el campus de la Universidad, incluyendo el acceso a distintos recursos institucionales (no monetarios) para sus actividades de investigación (bibliotecas, laboratorios, equipos, uso de aulas, etc.).
eligibility: Ciudadanos peruanos o extranjeros que hayan obtenido su grado académico de maestro.
Aspirar a cursar un doctorado en la PUCP con dedicación exclusiva y a tiempo completo.
Contar con el aval de un/a profesor/a del programa doctoral, quien asumirá el rol de asesor/a de tesis.
Dominio del idioma inglés a nivel B2, según el MCER, o superior.
Obtener la condición de ADMITIDO en el proceso de admisión Beca Doctoral 2027-1.

El Programa no está dirigido a docentes a tiempo completo de la PUCP ni a personas que durante el período de estudios doctorales desempeñen un cargo a tiempo completo de naturaleza ejecutiva, investigativa, administrativa o de cualquier otra índole, dentro o fuera de la PUCP.
No se consideran dentro de este Programa a los doctorados de Centrum PUCP ni al Doctorado en Gestión Estratégica del Consorcio de Universidades.
requirements: Inscribirse en el proceso de admisión de Beca Doctoral 2027-1 y obtener la condición de ADMITIDO del respectivo programa doctoral.
Presentar un ensayo personal (statement of purpose) con extensión máxima de dos (02) páginas.
Presentar un proyecto de investigación doctoral con extensión máxima de cinco (5) páginas a espacio simple, sin incluir referencias, más el cronograma.
Presentar una hoja de vida en la que se detalle la experiencia académica y profesional, así como la producción científica.
Presentar dos (02) cartas de recomendación adjuntadas directamente por los expertos que las suscriben en la plataforma Kissflow.
Presentar una carta de compromiso del asesor de tesis.
Presentar la Declaración de Ética e Integridad en la Investigación.
Presentar un certificado de inglés con el nivel B2 o equivalente a nivel intermedio completo, o superior.
Obtener un puntaje igual o superior a 18 sobre 20 (percentil 90) en la evaluación del Comité Directivo del programa doctoral para pasar a la etapa de selección.

selection_criteria: Evaluación sobre una escala del 0 al 20 por el Comité Directivo del programa doctoral: Parte 1 Proyecto de investigación (peso 0.35).
Parte 2 CV + experiencia académica y de investigación (peso 0.35), con rúbricas diferenciadas para egresados con 6 años o más y para candidatos recién egresados de 0 a 5 años.
Parte 3 Carta de motivación (ensayo personal) + entrevista (peso 0.20).
Puntaje mínimo de 18 (percentil 90) para ser considerado elegible; la selección la realiza el VRI-DFI en base al orden de mérito general y a los recursos disponibles de la Universidad.
Mínimo cero y máximo dos becas por programa doctoral: en primera ronda una beca al mejor ubicado de cada programa, y en segunda ronda a los segundos candidatos mejor ubicados.
Los resultados son definitivos e inapelables y se publican en el portal web del VRI y la EP.

application_method: Inscribirse en el proceso de admisión de Beca Doctoral 2027-1 (del 10 de agosto al 4 de noviembre de 2026).

Pagar el derecho de postulación: postulantes regulares S/550, graduados PUCP S/150 (BBVA, BCP, pago en línea con VISA, MASTERCARD o AMEX, o Tesorería PUCP), del 11 de agosto al 5 de noviembre de 2026.
Entregar los documentos para la etapa de evaluación a través de la plataforma Kissflow (del 17 de agosto al 5 de noviembre de 2026).
Rendir la Evaluación de Competencias Académicas para el Posgrado (ECAP) el sábado 7 de noviembre de 2026, de 3:00 p.m. a 5:00 p.m.
Solicitar a los/las recomendadores/as que adjunten sus cartas directamente en la plataforma Kissflow, dentro de los plazos de la convocatoria.
official.application_route: Register in the PUCP doctoral admission process for the Beca Doctoral 2027-1, pay the registration fee, and upload the seven application documents through the Kissflow platform; the doctoral programme's Directing Committee scores the file and the VRI-DFI awards the grants in merit order.
official.study_mode: full-time, exclusive dedication (a tiempo completo y con dedicación exclusiva); in-person doctoral programmes on the Lima campus
official.citizenship_residency: Open to Peruvian or foreign citizens ('ciudadanos peruanos o extranjeros'); no nationality or residency restriction is published.
official.international_eligibility: Yes. The call is addressed to 'ciudadanos peruanos o extranjeros' who hold a master's degree, so no nationality bar is published; foreign applicants must hold a PUCP thesis adviser and meet the same B2 English rule.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The doctoral proposal must be articulated with the consolidated research lines of the doctoral programme and developed, preferably, within VRI-recognised research groups or PUCP centres, research institutes or laboratories. The Centrum PUCP doctorates and the Consorcio de Universidades' Doctorado en Gestión Estratégica are excluded from this Programme.
official.research_requirement: A doctoral research project of at most five pages (single-spaced, excluding references, plus the work schedule) linked to the programme's research lines, backed by a commitment letter from a PUCP professor who will act as thesis adviser; during the grant the beneficiary must produce at least one first-author publication and one refereed oral conference paper.
official.duration: One (1) calendar year, renewable up to a maximum of two opportunities; the benefit cannot exceed the three-year doctoral plan of studies (four years for the Mathematics doctorate).
official.description: The Vicerrectorado de Investigación (VRI), together with the Escuela de Posgrado (EP), runs the Programa de Apoyo a la Investigación Doctoral to promote full-time dedication among doctoral students so that high-quality research projects with impact can be developed, with proposals linked preferentially to VRI-recognised research groups and to PUCP centres, institutes and laboratories.
official.program_type: Doctoral scholarship (Beca Doctoral) awarded through the PUCP doctoral admission process
official.english_requirement: Certificado de inglés con nivel B2 (MCER) o equivalente a 'nivel intermedio completo', o superior; no specific IELTS or TOEFL score is published.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a merit-based PUCP doctoral grant that pays your doctoral tuition and matrícula outright and adds S/ 4,000 a month for up to three years, but it is granted through a special doctoral admission round with its own early deadline of 4 November 2026. The single hardest condition is not money: you must already have a named PUCP professor who has signed a commitment letter to supervise your thesis before you apply, and you must reach 18 out of 20 in your programme's own scoring. Foreign master's graduates are explicitly eligible, so the main practical hurdle is securing a supervisor and proving B2 English rather than nationality or funding.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A master's graduate with a publishable five-page research proposal in a PUCP doctoral field who has already contacted a PUCP professor able to supervise it and can commit full time with no other job.
application_readiness_checklist: Email two or three PUCP doctoral professors whose published work matches your topic and ask for the thesis-adviser commitment letter before the call closes; without that letter your file is not eligible.

Prepare the B2 (MCER) English certificate early and confirm the issuing body's equivalences are accepted - a certificate not recognised as 'intermedio completo' or above will sink an otherwise strong file.

Draft the five-page single-spaced research project around the programme's own research lines and include a realistic work schedule, since viability, originality and literature coverage carry most of the 0.35 weight.
Book your two recommenders months ahead and brief them that they must upload their letters themselves through Kissflow and comment on your specific research contribution.
Budget the S/550 registration fee (S/150 if you graduated from PUCP) and note the differentiated discounts for non-PUCP graduates end on 18 September and again after 12 October.
Check the ECAP academic-competencies exam date (7 November 2026, 3-5 p.m.) and plan to sit it, and keep the programme interview window of 10-17 November free.
common_rejection_risks: Failing to reach the 18/20 cut-off in the doctoral programme's own evaluation, which is the only gate into the VRI merit ranking - a programme whose best candidate scores 17.9 gets no grant at all.
Losing the grant because the adviser commitment letter is missing or only names a willingness in principle rather than a clear commitment to supervise the thesis.
Missing that the call's registration deadline is 4 November 2026, not the general doctoral admission deadline in February 2027, and paying the fee or uploading documents after 5 November 2026.
A project that does not map onto the programme's consolidated research lines, or a five-page limit breach or missing work schedule, which costs points on the heaviest rubric section.
Being ruled out by the exclusivity rules: holding any full-time executive, research or administrative post, or being a PUCP full-time teacher, disqualifies you regardless of score.
Recommendation letters arriving late because they must be uploaded by the referees themselves in Kissflow rather than by the applicant.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The applicant funds the registration fee (S/550 regular, S/150 PUCP graduates), the ECAP and interview logistics, any travel, relocation and visa costs to Lima since no travel or installation allowance is published, plus living costs in Lima above the S/ 4,000 monthly allowance, and any medical coverage beyond the PUCP personal-accident insurance and beyond the three-year maximum benefit period.
document_audit: The project is capped at five single-spaced pages excluding references but including the work schedule - an appendix over the limit reads as an inability to follow instructions.

The motivation essay must contain all seven sections set out in Annex III (motivation, background, research experience, future interests, why PUCP, long-term goals, closing) in no more than two pages.
The CV template differs depending on whether you graduated six or more years ago or within the last five years, so pick the right rubric before writing it.
The thesis-adviser letter has no mandatory format but must state both the endorsement of your application and the commitment to supervise the doctoral thesis.
The ethics and integrity declaration is a signed statement addressed to the Vicerrector de Investigación, not a generic form - it must be completed and signed by you.
alerts: Application runs 10 August to 4 November 2026 with fee payment and Kissflow uploads closing 5 November 2026, and the eligibility review begins 20 November 2026 - there is no grace period.

You must first be ADMITTED to the doctorate before the grant is awarded; admission results are published 19 November 2026 and the beneficiary list on 3 December 2026, with agreements signed 9-11 December 2026.
The allowance is capped at the three-year doctoral plan of studies, or four years only for the Mathematics doctorate, so a delayed thesis falls outside the benefit.
Accepting the grant means exclusive full-time dedication: teaching is allowed only at PUCP, at most 3 credits per semester (or 4 as practicum head), and never at another institution.

Winning obliges you to produce at least one first-author publication meeting Anexo II standards (typically an accepted Q1/Q2 Scopus or Web of Science article) and one refereed oral conference paper, and failure to meet commitments triggers repayment of the grant.
Centrum PUCP doctorates and the Consorcio de Universidades' Doctorado en Gestión Estratégica are excluded, so check your target programme is one of the 15 PUCP doctorates in the call.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register online in the Beca Doctoral 2027-1 admission process, pay the fee by 5 November, upload all seven documents (including the adviser letter) to Kissflow by 5 November, sit the ECAP exam on 7 November and the programme interview around 10-17 November, then wait for the admission result on 19 November and the grant list on 3 December.
